title: Percival Lowell's Martian irrigation canals
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Percival Lowell's Martian irrigation canals, about late 19th century at Mars, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: on Mars but LEL went as far as to claim that parts of these dark areas and patterns were purposefully built irrigation systems designed by a martian civilization

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls Percival Lowell, an astronomer of the late 1800s who studied Mars through a telescope. Michels says Lowell went so far as to claim that some of the dark areas and patterns he saw were irrigation canals built on purpose by a Martian civilization, which would have meant intelligent life next door.
